patthana16.76:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṁ upādinnaṁ → upādiṇṇaṁ (bj); anidassana appaṭighaṁ upādiṇṇaṁ (bj) | anidassanaappaṭighaṁ upādinnaṁ dhammaṁ → ca sampayuttake ca khandhe (pts)
patthana16.76:2.1: cha sahajāte nissaye → nava (pts) | vipāke → nava ārammaṇe nava (pts) | vippayutte atthiyā → tīṇi anantare tīṇi (pts)
